classification.difficultyReason: Apply vertical and horizontal dilation factors to a supplied graph, including reciprocal horizontal factors.

content.prompt:
The graph of $y=f(x)$ is shown below. Each grid square has side length one unit.

Sketch the graphs of:

spec.sourceRegion: Question 5 supplied graph in the right column
spec.description: Eight-by-eight unit grid with perpendicular axes, positive-direction arrowheads, x and y labels, no numerical tick labels, and a blue V-shaped graph with closed outer endpoints.
spec.mathematics: Segments join (-2,2), (0,0), (2,2); grid step is 1 on both axes and bounds are -4 to 4.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied graph remains visible in the question edition.

answer.worked: Dilate vertically by a factor of $2$, keeping each $x$-coordinate unchanged and doubling each $y$-coordinate. Join $(-2,4)$, $(0,0)$ and $(2,4)$ with straight segments; retain closed outer endpoints.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 5(a); teacher PDF page 33, printed page 362, Section C 5(a)
spec.description: Complete solution graph on an eight-by-eight unit grid, with labelled axes and closed outer endpoints.
spec.mathematics: Vertical dilation by factor 2: (-2,2) becomes (-2,4), (0,0) stays fixed, and (2,2) becomes (2,4).

answer.worked: Dilate vertically by a factor of $\frac{1}{2}$, keeping each $x$-coordinate unchanged and halving each $y$-coordinate. Join $(-2,1)$, $(0,0)$ and $(2,1)$ with straight segments; retain closed outer endpoints.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 5(b); teacher PDF page 33, printed page 362, Section C 5(b)
spec.description: Complete solution graph on an eight-by-eight unit grid, with labelled axes and closed outer endpoints.
spec.mathematics: Vertical dilation by factor 1/2: segments join (-2,1), (0,0), (2,1).

answer.worked: Dilate horizontally by a factor of $\frac{1}{2}$, halving each $x$-coordinate and keeping each $y$-coordinate unchanged. Join $(-1,2)$, $(0,0)$ and $(1,2)$ with straight segments; retain closed outer endpoints.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 5(c); teacher PDF page 33, printed page 362, Section C 5(c)
spec.description: Complete solution graph on an eight-by-eight unit grid, with labelled axes and closed outer endpoints.
spec.mathematics: Horizontal dilation by factor 1/2: segments join (-1,2), (0,0), (1,2).

answer.worked: Dilate horizontally by a factor of $2$, doubling each $x$-coordinate and keeping each $y$-coordinate unchanged. Join $(-4,2)$, $(0,0)$ and $(4,2)$ with straight segments; retain closed outer endpoints.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 5(d); teacher PDF page 33, printed page 362, Section C 5(d)
spec.description: Complete solution graph on an eight-by-eight unit grid, with labelled axes and closed outer endpoints.
spec.mathematics: Horizontal dilation by factor 2: segments join (-4,2), (0,0), (4,2).
